proof_contract.dft_alias_identity: the N-point DFT coefficient at exponent 2n aliases only exponents 2n+lN
proof_contract.interval_policy: every raw coefficient ball is enlarged symmetrically by the analytic alias bound before quotients and determinants
proof_contract.double_evaluation: D_n is evaluated through q-ratios and through a direct 3x3 Toeplitz determinant

decision: The alias-repaired Xi coefficient balls rigorously certify translated D3 for every integer 2<=n<=126. This closes the finite seam only; an analytic or independently certified tail for n>=127 is still required.

scope.proved_if_pass: D_n>0 for the true Xi coefficients for all 2<=n<=126
does_not_prove: full PF3 (only H811 consecutive-row consequences are relevant)
